**ACCEPT** — reviewer of record: PM loop (QA wave #9296), session `session_01Ai9gUdihXjg7FumzsBNSSs`.

**21/21 scored.** 7 PASS / 12 PARTIAL / 2 FAIL / 0 not-run.

## The part that matters most: this round corrected the PM

I had written into #9296's standing-facts block that `studio-authoring.first-run-loop` was unscoreable because "Studio is not installed", and the dispatch brief told this round to **record `blocked` and move on**. The runner checked anyway, found the App Builder UI reachable at `/_console/studio`, and drove the full loop: **6/6 clauses pass, zero restarts.** Scored `pass`.

That is the right call and the right instinct. The claim was an inference I propagated from an earlier round without measuring, and left standing it would have cost every future round a P0 item. #9296's body now carries the entry **struck through rather than deleted**, plus a new rule above the list: *inherited facts are briefing material, not verdicts — if your evidence contradicts one, follow your evidence.* A wrong fact left visible teaches that rule; a quietly deleted one teaches nothing.

## Verified independently

The new defect's *acceptance* half is expected behaviour, which is what makes the read half anomalous: `view` carries `allowOrgOverride: true` in `packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts`, unlike `object` / `field` / `hook` / `seed` which are `false`. So the 200 receipt is correct and the missing read door is the defect. Extracted to **#9455** with the controls intact — shipped-view control ruling out a broken read path, org-scoping confound ruled out (one `sys_organization` row, and it is the session's active org), 4 saves × 3 names × 2 objects × 2 boots.

## The false P0 that was caught rather than filed

After `clearCookies()` the console rendered a fully authed shell — which reads *exactly* like the item's own c3 failure mode, "dead shell rendering stale data as if authed". The self-check found the console authenticates by **bearer token in `localStorage`**, so clearing cookies expired nothing; true expiry via `POST /auth/sign-out` behaves correctly (401 on the wire, redirect to login). **The item's step 5 is wrong for this build**, which is a checklist defect, not a platform one.

This is the single most valuable thing a browser round produces. A filed P0 here would have consumed a triage cycle, a dev dispatch, and a retraction — and it would have looked completely convincing on the way in.

## Carried into close-out

- `records-forms.crud-roundtrip` c2 — the `f_lookups` DELETE outage, third reproduction and the first through the console door, with a `showcase_category` DELETE-200 control. Already filed as **#9390**; no new card.
- 9 checklist-accuracy findings (a retired OWD gate an item still tests, a `publish` sub-route that 404s for `permission`, capability specimens on `showcase_field_zoo` not `zoo`, 11 settings namespaces not 10, the wrong step 5 above) join the consolidated ledger-edit PR — now 26 corrections across four rounds, one docs-only change with `revision` bumps.
- 7 fixture gaps join #9308.
- `first-run-loop` should also lose any inherited assumption in the ledger itself, not just on this card.

Tier-2C (final 18 unpinned P0/P1 browser/mixed) dispatched. When it lands, every unpinned P0/P1 item in the ledger has a verdict.

**Close-out — extracted.** Wave #9296, executed under #9480. Four-way FAIL disposition applied to this record's own evidence; nothing re-judged, nothing re-run.

## FAIL disposition (2 FAILs)

**1 · `records-forms.crud-roundtrip` c2 → (a) product defect → #9362, linked not refiled.** The `f_lookups` DELETE outage, confirmed here a third time and for the first time through the console door, with the `showcase_category` DELETE 200 control. This round correctly filed no new card. #9362 carries an open fix PR (#9437).

**2 · `studio-authoring.view-authoring-live` c3 → (a) product defect → #9454.** A runtime-authored `view` accepted with a 200 `state:'active'` receipt and served by no read door. Extracted at review time from this record; **linked, not refiled**. The card's scope was widened the same day when Tier-2C #9467 found the identical shape on `dashboard` — kept as one card deliberately, so one mechanism does not get two half-fixes. Worth noting the earliest sighting: #9353 recorded a `PUT /meta/view` 200 followed by a 404 read and declined to score it, on thin evidence, as a fail; this round supplied the missing half (published/active state, 4 saves, 3 names, 2 objects, 2 independent boots, org and read-door confounds ruled out).

Both fixes land in this repo — the API read door is already wrong before the console is involved, so neither is an objectui defect.

## PARTIAL gaps — no cards, by rule

The 9 checklist-accuracy findings (CF-1…CF-9) and 7 fixture gaps (FG-1…FG-7) itemised above are **parked on the wave anchor** per the PM's 2026-08-18 comment; the security-priority pin upgrades from the wave's gap inventory are already filed as #9481 #9482 #9483 and this record's gaps are not to be re-filed against them. Two of the CFs have already earned their own follow-ups elsewhere: the `owd-save-gate` R1 divergence (CF-3) is #9477, and the RUNNER.md carve-out this round's discipline depends on is #9471.

**One correction from this round is now wave doctrine.** `studio-authoring.first-run-loop` is **not** blocked on stock showcase — the Studio *app registration* is absent, but the App Builder UI is reachable and the loop closes 6/6 with zero restarts. The PM had instructed this round to record `blocked` and move on; the runner checked anyway. The standing fact on #9296 is corrected and left struck through rather than deleted.

Extracted: #9454
Parked-on: #9296
